IMPLEMENTED.description: Fully realized in repo code with verified working implementation.

PARTIAL.description: Code exists but incomplete, missing subsystems, or unlinked.

DEFINED.description: Architecturally formalized, typed, or schema-specified; no runtime implementation yet.

REFERENCED.description: Named and called in comments, imports, or docs, but external or unprovided.

PRIVATE / NOT VISIBLE.description: Known institutional component residing in private enterprise repositories.

PROPOSED.badge_class: bg-amber-950/80 text-amber-300 border-dashed border-amber-600/70 font-mono text-[11px]
PROPOSED.description: Target architecture RFC / specification item. MUST NEVER be styled as an existing capability.

visual_enhancers.grid_borders: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) with high precision technical crosshairs on headers
visual_enhancers.code_blocks: Deep obsidian background (#070A10), subtle 1px border, line numbering, copy button with success feedback, language badge in top right
visual_enhancers.mermaid_container: Solid slate container (#0B1120) with subtle grid background, zoom/reset controls, export SVG/PNG button, clear rendering state
visual_enhancers.spec_metadata_header: Institutional RFC-style bounding box: Status badge, Attribution level (CONCEPT / SPECIFICATION / IMPLEMENTATION / DEPLOYED RUNTIME), Canonical Path, Version, Owner, Evidence Source Links
visual_enhancers.unverified_edges: Dashed lines with warning annotation in target architecture comparisons to prevent speculation confusion

motion.philosophy: Restrained, deterministic, zero-fluff micro-interactions suited for serious systems engineering docs
motion.accessibility_reduced_motion: Wrap animations with @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { transition: none !important; }

accessibility.contrast_standard: Strict WCAG AA and APCA compliant for low-light specification reading
accessibility.keyboard_nav: Full arrow key navigation in tree view, [Cmd+K] / [/] focus on search, Esc to close modals
accessibility.screen_reader_tags: aria-expanded on tree folders, aria-current on active spec, data-testid on all interactive nodes
accessibility.status_distinction: Status values never rely solely on color; they always include the textual status label and distinctive shape/border treatment (e.g., dashed for PROPOSED)

instructions_to_main_agent.architecture_rule: The Markdown documents on disk represent the canonical truth. The web portal is a high-fidelity renderer and forensic auditor. Ensure all 8 canonical sections are cleanly represented in the sidebar tree.
instructions_to_main_agent.status_treatment: PROPOSED status must be visibly distinct (dashed amber border, 'TARGET SPEC' watermark or label) so no reader confuses a planned feature for an existing system capability.
instructions_to_main_agent.mermaid_integration: Install or import mermaid for rendering diagram code fences (```mermaid ... ```). Fallback cleanly to formatted code if rendering fails.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing_ids: Ensure all navigation links, search inputs, status filter badges, and table sort controls have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='tree-nav-item-architecture-kernel', data-testid='status-filter-implemented').
instructions_to_main_agent.no_saas_gradients: Avoid colorful AI-gradient gimmicks or floaty cards. Maintain Swiss-style technical rigor, crisp grid borders, high density data tables, and clean typography.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.avoid_ai_slop: Do not use generic centered layouts, purple glow gradients, or AI emojis. Use strict IBM Plex Sans/Mono typography, restrained status tokens, and dense information architecture.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Maintain comfortable reading measure (max 75 characters per line in Markdown text) with generous whitespace between technical sub-sections.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.components: Use the shipped base-nova shadcn components (Table, Dialog, Tabs, Badge, Button, Input, DropdownMenu, Select) with custom dark sovereign styling.
